name: Cloudflare
title: Cloudflare: an API token for each zone, typed in and kept sealed

permissions: calls Cloudflare's API for a zone with the token kept for it, by zone name, never showing it
sets up a zone's Email Routing (mail forwarding): never removes or replaces a DNS record without replace_mx, and only the MX and SPF records it names
touches.remove: the Settings group's card in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, cloudflarepage.js/.css, rouh/cloudflare.py, rouh/web/cloudflare.py, the cloudflare tool in rouh/tools.py and this manifest; drop the cloudflare_zones table with a migration.
